findings.before: An entry crossing 0 could be selected although viewportSize=0 defines an empty visible region.
findings.resolution: Only visible-preferred requires viewportSize>0; paired control preserves first-crossing for the same frame and does not retire restoration hints.

findings.before: The first WC fixture treated terminal DOM detach as a retained session remount.
findings.resolution: WC now proves old public handles are revoked; a separate real RuntimeSession unmount/mount test proves the retained-instance epoch and selection-ticket boundaries. Catalog wording excludes position-ticket replay.

findings.before: Hint-only assertions did not discriminate repeated selection pause.
findings.resolution: Both pending and completed replay require history mode to remain history as well as retaining the initial hint.
